description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Amway is seeking an Enterprise Integration Software Engineer to help build and operate a scalable enterprise integration backbone connecting legacy applications with modern cloud-native platforms. The role focuses on developing integration solutions, APIs, microservices, automation scripts, observability capabilities, and CI/CD workflows across global technology ecosystems.
Enterprise integration engineer building Apache Camel routes, Kafka pipelines, API services, and cloud-native automation

Responsibilities:
• Ecosystem Mastery: You will understand how modern enterprise systems interlock, preparing you for future leadership roles as a Principal Architect, Lead Integration Engineer, or Enterprise Platform Owner
• Executive Visibility: Because integration is the engine that transforms IT from a cost center into an agile value-driver, your work directly impacts business continuity, market expansion, and digital innovation
• Succession Pipeline: Designed specifically for an Intern Conversion, this position is built to fast-track high-potential talent into core architecture roles through active mentorship, high-stakes exposure, and accelerated ownership
• Day 30: Familiarize yourself with our multi-cloud environment (GCP, AWS), container runtimes (Cloud Run, EKS), basic YAML DSL structures in Apache Camel, and developer self-service portals, while achieving full operational familiarity with Managed File Transfer (MFT) workflows. Audit initial Confluent Kafka topic provisioning and Apigee X setups, while establishing hands-on proficiency across our enterprise observability, log storage, and tracing solutions—including Prometheus, Grafana, Google Cloud Observability, and Cloud Storage
• Day 60: Be actively involved in developing a modern Apache Camel integration solution while gaining hands-on execution experience (the "I do" phase) across all major integration platforms and developer self-service portals which include Confluent/Apache Kafka, Apigee X, Apache Camel, Airflow (MFT), GCP, and various Cloud Run implementations
• Day 90: Elevate to the "I teach" level of mastery across developer self-service portals while putting your engineering skills to work in production code, writing robust Java/Spring Boot micro-services, building custom Camel routes, and engineering Python utility automation scripts. You will leverage a solid engineering fluency in Apache Camel, Apigee X, and Kafka to transform complex distributed system requirements into clean, maintainable software that actively drives a Zero-Support architecture free of Single Points of Failure (SPOFs)
• Full-Cycle Execution & Ecosystem Perspective: You naturally identify manual friction and build automated solutions using CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and modern streaming patterns. You assist in writing unit tests, performing integration testing, and supporting automated CI/CD pipelines to deliver high-quality, reliable deployments
• T-Shaped Growth & Zero-Support Mentality: You rapidly transition from executing tasks under guidance to leading deep-dives, converting manual friction into automated self-service, and turning "black box" systems into clear, documented architectures. You participate actively in code reviews and learn software development best practices in a highly collaborative environment
• Modernization & Technical Versatility: You bring technical curiosity to bridge legacy COTS applications with future-ready platforms like Kafka, Apigee X, Airflow, and Camel. You stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in enterprise integration, APIs, and cloud-native development
• AI-Augmented Productivity: You possess the proficiency to use AI tools as a standard daily resource to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate routine tasks
• Authentic Collaboration: You communicate with radical candor and empathy by tackling friction head-on rather than talking around it. You partner closely with your peers to translate complex requirements into clean, maintainable, production-ready code

Requirements:
• A Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent professional/internship experience
• Foundational knowledge in Java, Spring Boot, Python, or similar languages, alongside familiarity with API concepts (REST/SOAP), JSON, and YAML DSL structures
• Ability to assist in the design, development, and testing of APIs and integration services, as well as write, troubleshoot, and debug backend services and utility scripts using JavaScript and Python
• Hands-on exposure to or a strong desire to master core enterprise integration technologies
• This includes contributing to integration workflows using Apache Camel, automating workflows, supporting event-driven processing and streaming use cases using Confluent Kafka, and participating in API development, deployment, and management using Apigee X
• Exposure to cloud environments (GCP or AWS), container platforms (Cloud Run, EKS, Docker), and monitoring/logging platforms like Grafana
• You live out your values every day, taking ownership of your growth and moving eagerly from passive observation to active engineering
• You demonstrate a willingness to learn, take initiative, and contribute actively to team knowledge-sharing
• Amway does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Amway immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, STEM OPT, TN, etc.) now or in the future
